Class Pokemon

java.lang.Object
Pokemon
public class Pokemon extends Object
Represents a Pokemon record retrieved from the SQLite database (`pokemon.db`). Stores Pokedex metadata, elemental types, base combat statistics, physical dimensions, and legendary classification for Generation 1 through 3 Pokemon.

  • Constructor Details

    • Pokemon

      public Pokemon(int id, String name, int generation, String type1, String type2, String species, int hp, int attack, int defense, int spAttack, int spDefense, int speed, int total, double heightM, double weightKg, boolean isLegendary)
      Constructs a new Pokemon object with all attributes from the database.
      Parameters:
      id - the National Pokedex number (1 to 386)
      name - the name of the Pokemon
      generation - the generation in which the Pokemon was introduced (1, 2, or 3)
      type1 - the primary elemental type (e.g., "Fire", "Water", "Grass")
      type2 - the secondary elemental type, or null if single-typed
      species - the Pokedex classification species (e.g., "Flame Pokemon")
      hp - the base Hit Points (HP) stat
      attack - the base physical Attack stat
      defense - the base physical Defense stat
      spAttack - the base Special Attack stat
      spDefense - the base Special Defense stat
      speed - the base Speed stat
      total - the sum of all six base stats (Base Stat Total)
      heightM - the height of the Pokemon in meters
      weightKg - the weight of the Pokemon in kilograms
      isLegendary - true if the Pokemon is Legendary or Mythical; false otherwise
